messages:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — I'm sketching a 12-18mo topology vision: build stable tenant guardrails that let us route by latency/cost/compliance, enable per-tenant isolation lanes, and default graceful fallbacks. Need feedback on: launch metrics (SLOs + ops readiness), prioritization of customer asks (SLA vs cost), and proposed rollout stages.

Marco Li: +1. Recommend metric trio: P95 latency, % requests using fallback, cost per 1M tokens. Also need tenant resource quotas and throttling primitives.

Jules (eng-arch): Agree. Suggest phased launch:
1) routing policy proto (region affinity + model tier)
2) isolation lanes (soft, per-tenant slices)
3) hardened legal/compliance lanes
Each stage gated by runbook and SLA smoke tests.

Maya SRE: Ops concerns — add health spillover tests and an eviction playbook. We should rehearse a simulated tenant surge during stage 2.

Ken Product: From customers: VPC+isolation and guaranteed throughput are top asks. We need to surface pricing delta and SLA language in stage 2.

Priya Rao: Proposed launch criteria:
- P95 latency < 300ms for priority tier
- fallback rate < 1% across 7 days
- successful canary with 3 pilot customers
- full runbook drill completed

Marco Li: Can we tighten fallback definition? Suggest: per-tenant fallback <=0.5% over 24h then relax to 1% during rollouts. Also define cooldowns for evictions.

Jules (eng-arch): Example routing config snippet:

```
routing_policy:
  priority: ["regional-affinity","cost"]
  fallback: ["model-compact","region-pair"]
  isolation: "soft-slice"
```

Maya SRE: :thumbsup: Also telemetry needs: per-route token counts, per-tenant cache hit rate, oom/eviction counters, and correlated request traces.

Ken Product: Customer asks to map:
1) strict data residency -> legal lane
2) reserved throughput -> dedicated lane
3) audit logs -> platform-wide feature, opt-in per tenant

Priya Rao: Mapping acknowledged. Note: dedicated lanes will raise unit cost and fragmentation risk — docs + pricing needed.

Jules (eng-arch): Risk note: dedicated lanes increase fragmentation. Include autoscaling policies and bin-packing heuristics in the roadmap to mitigate cost blowup.

Maya SRE: Ops go/no-go checklist for each stage:
- Canary >=72h at 100k QPS? (scale target)
- SLOs met at target load
- Rollback plan validated
- Incidentbot alerts wired and tested

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started by Priya Rao for infra/canaries/topology-v1 at 1761123600

Priya Rao: Action items:
- Jules to draft phased spec (doc link TBD)
- Marco to propose concrete metrics + thresholds
- Maya to author runbook drills and failure injects
- Ken to formalize customer asks and pricing impact
Back here Fri EOD? :calendar:

Ken Product: Friday EOD works for me.
